title: SuperDerm diagnostic taxonomy
source: SuperDerm preprint, supplementary tables of subgroups and diagnoses; rare and high-consequence designations by majority vote of five physicians (figures/data/per_dx_final.csv, 2026-11-16).

definitions.rare: Affects fewer than 1 in 2,000 people in the general population.
definitions.highConsequence: Missing it at the first assessment can lead to death, lasting harm or transmission, or delay an urgent intervention such as isolation or targeted treatment.
